en:
Deploy an emergency hiding spot. Most enemies will be less likely to notice you while you stand near it. Observant foes may not be so easily fooled.

Cannot be cast in combat.

Place at a Sulphur Vent.
There don't seem to be any collection supplies in the barrel.

Place beside Suspicious Collection Equipment.
The crate smells of charcoal.
Deliver to a supply officer for a substantial reward.
